<?php

$mod = 998244353;

function readln(): string
{
    return trim(fgets(STDIN));
}

function readint(): int
{
    return intval(readln());
}

function readlong(): int
{
    return intval(readln());
}

function readdouble(): float
{
    return floatval(readln());
}

function readstrings(): array
{
    return explode(' ', readln());
}

function readints(): array
{
    return array_map('intval', readstrings());
}

function readlongs(): array
{
    return array_map('intval', readstrings());
}

function readdoubles(): array
{
    return array_map('floatval', readstrings());
}

function pw(int $a, int $b): int
{
    global $mod;

    $c = $b;
    $d = $a;
    $res = 1;

    while ($c > 0) {
        if (($c & 1) !== 0) {
            $res = ($res * $d) % $mod;
        }

        $d = ($d * $d) % $mod;
        $c = intdiv($c, 2);
    }

    return $res;
}

function inv(int $a): int
{
    global $mod;
    return pw($a, $mod - 2);
}

$tt = 1;
$f = array_fill(0, 500010, 1);

for ($i = 2; $i <= 500000; $i++) {
    $f[$i] = ($f[$i - 1] * $i) % $mod;
}

while ($tt-- > 0) {
    [$n, $k] = readints();
    $ans = 0;

    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n - $k + 1; $i++) {
        $cnt = intdiv($n, $i);

        if ($cnt < $k) {
            continue;
        }

        $sum = ($f[$cnt - 1] * inv($f[$k - 1])) % $mod;
        $sum = (inv($f[$cnt - $k]) * $sum) % $mod;
        $ans = ($ans + $sum) % $mod;
    }

    echo $ans, PHP_EOL;
}

{
    $res = 1;

        if (($b & 1) !== 0) {
            $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        }
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $b = intdiv($b, 2);
    }

}

{

{
    return array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

{
    $res = 1;

    while ($b > 0) {
        if (($b & 1) !== 0) {
            $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        }

        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $b = intdiv($b, 2);
    }

    return $res;
}

function inv(int $a): int
{
    return pw($a, MOD - 2);

$factorial = array_fill(0, 500010, 1);

for ($i = 2; $i <= 500000; $i++) {
    $factorial[$i] = ($factorial[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;

$tt = 1;

    [$n, $k] = readInts();

source_data.prob_desc_description: We define $$$x \bmod y$$$ as the remainder of division of $$$x$$$ by $$$y$$$ ($$$\%$$$ operator in C++ or Java, mod operator in Pascal).Let's call an array of positive integers $$$[a_1, a_2, \dots, a_k]$$$ stable if for every permutation $$$p$$$ of integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$k$$$, and for every non-negative integer $$$x$$$, the following condition is met: $$$ (((x \bmod a_1) \bmod a_2) \dots \bmod a_{k - 1}) \bmod a_k = (((x \bmod a_{p_1}) \bmod a_{p_2}) \dots \bmod a_{p_{k - 1}}) \bmod a_{p_k} $$$ That is, for each non-negative integer $$$x$$$, the value of $$$(((x \bmod a_1) \bmod a_2) \dots \bmod a_{k - 1}) \bmod a_k$$$ does not change if we reorder the elements of the array $$$a$$$.For two given integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$, calculate the number of stable arrays $$$[a_1, a_2, \dots, a_k]$$$ such that $$$1 \le a_1 < a_2 < \dots < a_k \le n$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print one integer — the number of stable arrays $$$[a_1, a_2, \dots, a_k]$$$ such that $$$1 \le a_1 < a_2 < \dots < a_k \le n$$$. Since the answer may be large, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n, k \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$).
